name: research-with-sources
description: Answer research questions with real sources: search, read the actual pages, and cite what was actually read — never synthesize from memory alone.
procedure: search multiple engines and keep the top trusted results
open the most promising 2-3 URLs and extract their real content
ground every claim in the extracted text; drop any claim no source supports
list the sources actually read in the answer

examples.situation: user asks for current best practices for SQLite backups
examples.outcome: answer cites the pages actually opened

failureModes: citing a URL that was never opened
summarizing the search snippet instead of the page
verification: every cited URL appears in the tool-call record as actually fetched
